## About
Power Tires SD sells new and used tires and takes care of brakes and alignment from our shop on Imperial Ave in San Diego.
We see drivers from all over the area, including Chula Vista, National City, North Park, La Mesa, Eastlake, Bonita and the South Bay.
When a tire wobbles or you feel it in the steering wheel, we use computerized equipment that shows where the wheel weights belong. We hold a 4.2 rating on Google from 97 reviews.

## Services
- New and used tires: New and used tires to fit your car and your budget.
- Brakes and alignment: Brake work and wheel alignment to keep your car stopping and tracking straight.

## FAQ
Q: Can you repair my tire instead of replacing it?
A: If a tire can be repaired, we will tell you. One reviewer came in expecting to buy a used tire, and the mechanic repaired their old one instead.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: We are open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM and closed on Sunday.
